short: Sum the gains after subtracting penalties

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.SizeData₂.Ga
lean.plain: Sum the gains after subtracting penalties
lean.note: At each place the argument sums the gains of the lifts and subtracts the local cost $\tau_\lambda$. The place-weighted total $\mathrm{Ga}(u_0)$ is the common quantity in the count bound and the lower slope bound for $N_u$.
